_readme: This file is read at the start of every digest session. It tells Claude the archive history, current chart data, and what's working. Update it every publish run.

entries.summary: Markets reopen post-Memorial Day +0.7% on Iran peace optimism · WTI -5% sub-$100 · ZS earns tonight; MRVL + CRM Wednesday; DELL Thursday · 10Y 4.56%, 30Y above 5%, Dec hike at 35% odds.
Warsh sworn in as 17th Fed Chair · Iran ceasefire 'narrowing the gaps' · S&P 8th straight weekly gain, longest since 2023.

template_notes.archive_instruction: ALWAYS rebuild archive section from this state file's archive array. Never drop it.
template_notes.chart_instruction: Do NOT inject a new chart IIFE. Update data within the existing template chart block using string replacement.
template_notes.theme_toggle_instruction: The theme toggle JS is inside a self-contained IIFE tagged '// Theme toggle' in the inline script. Do not remove it.
template_notes.script_structure: 3 script tags: Chart.js CDN, datalabels CDN, one big inline script. The inline script has: sticky nav, bull/bear toggle, quiz, feedback, theme toggle, then chart init (wrapped in _initAllCharts + rAF), then narrative verdict updater, then scoring IIFE.
